scope: Acceptance-only question comparison helper and independent single-date accrual totals from existing archived API data. No product question rewriting, provider request or live execution. Includes the new helper import and additional same_question predicate at initial runner job-ID binding; unrelated runner mechanics are outside this follow-up.
checks: Question normalization is pure: it case-folds, normalizes ё, removes known skill-launch prefixes, maps explicit ordinal date/platform spellings and compares nonempty token sequences. It does not mutate the source question.

Locally available historical question/original_question pairs passed: 5 cases. Additional probes preserve date/platform distinctions, distinguish average-price from buyer-sum questions, and reject empty/non-string values.
Verifier imports the existing archive reader, which reads SQLite in mode=ro and verifies encrypted archive bytes. No API, model, socket or HTTP dispatch is made by the verifier.
Verifier requires a finished READY case, at least one accrual page, an empty final cursor, unique accrual IDs, one selected period with from=to, and matching row dates.

Per-product quantities and commission fields determine the totals. commission=null service rows are skipped; direction comes from sale_amount, buyer value from sale_price, seller value from sale_amount, and reverse monetary totals negate signed values without multiplying line totals by quantity.

Verifier checks positive integral quantity, RUB fields, seller_price times quantity equals sale_amount, and buyer plus bonus plus coinvestment equals seller amount. Average buyer price uses positive buyer total divided by positive quantity, with no divide-by-zero fallback.

No observed business result is hardcoded; expected_total is calculated from archived fields. The helper adds data_check to the local private case JSON and prints a summary; it is read-only toward the archive and application database, not toward that evidence JSON.
Both helpers compile; no remote/live/model calls were made during review.

Inspected current runner integration: same_question is imported, and original_question versus record.question is added with AND before initial job-ID persistence. Existing tenant/job-ID/time conditions remain unchanged; neither question is rewritten. AST comparison confirms exactly one added predicate conjunct.

verification.independent_local: 5 historical pairs plus targeted positive/negative identity probes PASS; compilation PASS; source arithmetic reviewed against canonical B05 mappings.
verification.reported_by_parent: 31 recorded question pairs 47–77 matched and question78 differs from79; only 5 historical pairs were available for independent local review. Cases79/80/81 subsequently bound correctly and produced independently checked values.
verification.runner_followup: Current runner import/predicate source and AST delta inspected; no runner execution or new live calls.

limitations: Question text equality prevents binding a different question; it is not a unique request identifier and cannot distinguish delayed callbacks for an identical repeated question.

Verifier checks terminal cursor and row uniqueness but does not independently reconstruct a multi-page cursor chain. Current one-page cases fit this review scope; completeness of a larger archive still relies on successful source execution/archive coverage.
Verifier computes independent expected values; it does not automatically parse or grade the model spoken answer.
